parsed.summary: The PR addresses the migration import ordering issue but may not fully resolve all edge cases.

issues.description: The PR does not handle cases where imports are already correctly ordered or when there are mixed import styles within the same section.
The PR does not include tests to verify that the new import ordering works as expected in various scenarios.
